name: vam-knowledge
description: Personal knowledge base: save what a session produced — an explanation, a draft of a message, a finding — into an Obsidian vault as a standalone document, filed under its ticket or, when it is lasting knowledge, under a flat knowledge area; recall it later by ticket, area, topic or full-text search. A follow-up save merges into the existing note instead of piling up duplicates. Vault-agnostic: the target vault is resolved at runtime from references/vaults.md, and mounted by a separate vam-vault-* connector plugin.
